name: Slow Speed
description: Sets the player’s speed to 0.8x of normal speed

name: Higher Gravity
description: Sets player’s gravity to 1.3x of normal gravity. Some jumps will kill them as they take more fall damage

name: Half Primary Ammo
description: Will cut their primary gun’s ammo amount in half

name: UziRules
description: Will make any weapon they pickup be an UZI smg

name: PrimaryDisable
description: Will prevent them entirely from picking up any guns, except secondary (melee / pistols)

name: SlowDrain
description: Will make the player slowly lose health over time

name: Clumsy
description: Will make the player drop the axe OR on demand

name: iCantSpellNoMore
description: Random letters in chat will be replaced with incorrect letters. 50% of the time it activates to keep it subtle.

name: CameTooEarly
description: [Not Implemented] When they shoot, random chance the empty their whole clip

name: KillMeSoftly
description: Will make the player switch to pills/adrenaline and try to give it away. Not fully implemented.

name: ThrowItall
description: Will make the player throw all their items at the nearest player.

name: GunJam
description: On reload, small chance their gun gets jammed, and they fail to reload

name: NoPickup
description: Prevents a player from picking up ANY new item.
subnotes: Use ThrowItAll to drop their items

name: Swarm
description: Will make all zombies, even ones that are “sleeping” swarm the player.
subnotes: Repeat mode will only work on one player at a time

name: Honk
description: honk

name: Special Magnet
description: Attracts ALL specials to the closest alive trolled target with this troll enabled

name: Tank Magnet
description: Attracts ALL tanks to the closest alive trolled target with this troll enabled

name: No Shove
description: Prevents player from shoving at a % chance
subnotes: Will still visually shove survivors, but will not affect the victim

name: Damage Boost
description: Will make the player take 2x more damage than normal

name: Temp Quick Drain
description: Will make a player’s temp health drain very quickly

name: Vomit Player
description: Vomits the player instantly

name: Vocalize Gag
description: Prevents player from sending any vocalizations (even automatic)
